zh:
香港大学（The University of Hong Kong，简称HKU）成立于1910年，是香港历史最悠久的公立研究型大学。学校采用书院制，下设10个学院，提供广泛的本科与研究生课程，覆盖医学、法学、商学、工程、人文社科等全领域，在校生超30000人。
香港大学在亚洲乃至全球享有极高学术声誉，培养了多位诺贝尔奖得主、菲尔兹奖得主、图灵奖得主，以及香港特别行政区多位核心领导人。学校国际化程度极高，教学与科研深度对接全球标准，在医学、法学、金融等领域稳居亚洲领先地位。2026QS世界大学排名中，香港大学位列世界第11位。
en: The University of Hong Kong (HKU) is a public research university in Hong Kong. Founded in 1910, HKU is Hong Kong's oldest institution of higher education. HKU operates under a collegiate system comprising 10 faculties, offering a wide range of undergraduate and graduate programs across medicine, law, business, engineering, and humanities and social sciences, with over 30,000 enrolled students. HKU has produced multiple Nobel Prize winners, Fields Medalists, and Turing Award winners, and holds a leading academic position in Asia and globally. Ranked No.11 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
